THE 92% REPRODUCES, unlike Session 1's 2.3x: 715 of 771 findings are Major (92.7%), stable at 92.7% under both sensitivity variants, with exactly 28 non-canonical values, the figure the spec named. THE FIELD STILL DOES NOT DISCRIMINATE, and the reason is stronger than the spec supposed. By round, Major share RISES (88.8 / 95.0 / 96.4 / 94.9 / 97.3%) and is_blocking_issue is TRUE on 100% of findings from round 3 onward; by phase, supplementary and remediation-review are 100% Major. The last Minor any verifier assigned is Set 082, committed 2026-07-06 - 49 sets and 698 findings ago - and in the ledger era where the bounded loop actually exists the field takes two values across 281 findings, Major 98.6% and Critical 1.4%, both blocking. Severity carries 0.511 bits of a possible 2.000; the gate's own answer carries 0.194. THE DECISIVE MEASUREMENT: of 249 ledgered rounds, 143 returned findings, the gate called 13 non-blocking, and 12 of those are supplementary rounds with zero findings that never end a loop by protocol - so the field has changed the course of exactly ONE round in the corpus, its deciding Minor was written by the Set 119 doc-only cap rather than by a verifier, and that session then ran three more rounds anyway. 106 of 107 loop terminations came from a round that reported nothing at all. AUTHORITY HELD: no gate was touched; every remedy that could make the loop stop earlier is surfaced as an operator-owned education-mode brief. THE VOCABULARY IS CLOSED at the writer in existing modules only, and the measurement reframed that work honestly - all 28 non-canonical values were written between 2026-07-02 and 2026-07-10 and none since, so this is a guard on a closed episode rather than a repair, but three live sources remained: the machinery's own 'unknown' sentinel at three production sites (removed in favour of key omission, byte-identical reader behaviour), 'Suggestion' offered by a shipped prompt template, and an unconstrained severity string in the submit_verdict tool schema.
